website.note: Pipeline page returned mostly CSS; relied on 10-K + ctgov

pipeline.modality: Lymph node-targeted amphiphile (AMP) therapeutic cancer vaccine; 7-peptide pool against mutant KRAS/NRAS
pipeline.target: Mutant KRAS / NRAS (G12D, G12R, G12V, G12A, G12C, G12S, G13D)

indications.indication: KRAS/NRAS-mutated solid tumors (incl. pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, colorectal cancer) — minimal residual disease setting
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 study of ELI-002 7P in patients with KRAS/NRAS mutated solid tumors after locoregional therapy
key_milestones: Sep 2025: 99% of evaluable patients showed robust mKRAS-specific T cell responses (avg 145.3x baseline)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 1 completed; superseded by 7-peptide ELI-002 7P in AMPLIFY-7P
